about_the_game:
Story

Mount Mikago, located in a remote part of Japan.

It is an ordinary, small mountain, the kind you find anywhere.

Recently, several rumors about Mikagoyama had been whispered about, though their veracity remained unclear.

The water that springs from that mountain heals any injury.

Those who are captivated by that mountain vanish from this world.

They say that mountain holds the entrance to paradise.

June 1999.Various people set foot on Mount Mikago.

Each to fulfill their hidden purpose.

Overview

This game is a horror RPG.

This is a horror-themed RPG game. It also incorporates roguelike and tabletop RPG elements.

The primary objective is for players to explore a mountain where inexplicable phenomena occur and uncover the cause.

First, you will create a character that serves as the player's avatar.

Combine various occupations and traits to create your very own character.

Once the exploration begins, unknown difficulties and terrors await the player.

By leveraging the characteristics of the characters you've created, you will overcome these challenges.

It would be extremely difficult to explore every corner and uncover the truth on your first attempt.

However, even if you exhaust your strength during exploration, it's no problem.

Players can receive benefits upon restarting based on the choices and actions they made within the game.

Using that blessing as your weapon, advance step by step and uncover the truth behind the strange occurrences in the mountains.

Character

Yodomi

　A woman wearing a pantsuit and a gas mask.

　For a certain reason, she refuse to show their face and never remove their gas mask.

Urano

　An unhealthy-looking young man. Self-proclaimed, hands-on occult enthusiast.

　He heard a rumor about Mikagoyama and came to this place to verify the truth.

Misaki

She is a student at a university near Mt. Mikorō and is majoring in animal studies. For unknown reasons, she has an extreme aversion to contact with people.
